title: Transformation & People Strategist
full_description:
At ING we are looking for a Transformation & People Strategist
Your role and work environment
Do you believe that sustainable transformation happens when people and performance evolve together? Are you passionate about making change that truly matters?
If so, this role is for you.
As aTransformation & People Strategist, you will play a key role in driving sustainable transformation in thePublic Entities. You will be part of the Transformation & People Strategists Team, reporting to theChallenger Lead, within ING’sTransformation Office Tribe.
It’s a hands-on role inside the Leadership team, acting as partner and driver for strategic topics with high tribe-wide relevance. You will bring your helicopter view to connect dots and elevate conversations. You’ll act as a force multiplier by helping the Tribe Lead and People Leaders to go out-of-silo mode while co-shaping an overarching perspective on people engagement and performance.
Positioned at the heart of the tribe, You're not a support function.You are changing catalystchallenging patterns and connecting the dots between performance and fostering people development—ultimately helping the tribe thrive.
You will be part of a growing Transformation & People Strategists Team that supports each other, shares learnings, and evolves together as a transformation capability inside ING.
You’ll work close to Tribe Leads, People Leaders, HR Business Partners and Talent & Training
You turn insights into outcomes. Strategy into execution. Complexity into clarity.
Your key responsibilities
Lead the intersection ofPeople & Productivity, spotting and activating the engagement–performance bridge. Develop alignment on what ‘good’ looks like.
Lead thePeople Agenda,structuring regular leadership conversations on engagement, development, performance and workforce planning.
Drive theUnlock Full Potential strategy, enabling visibility and career paths for high-potential talent across the Tribe.
Manage theTribe’s training budget, aligning learning investments with strategic priorities.
Be astrategic Transformation & People Strategist, giving direction where needed, sparking courageous conversations and guiding leadership reflection with bold, constructive input.
Take ownership ofchange initiatives,from design to implementation and impact tracking, especially those that aim to improve people engagement and productivity.
Influence decisionswith data, using metrics to reveal pain points and support decisions, working across tech and business domains.
Co-design, implement and monitor tribe-wide learning investments or engagement initiatives in collaboration with people leaders and the Transformation Office.
Accelerate execution: improve delivery focus, risk visibility and leadership alignment across business and tech.
Facilitate a culture of reflection and continuous learning, increasing awareness and driving better decision-making.
Act on data: use Pulse, OHI, performance metrics and team feedback to challenge the status quo and drive better decisions.
Be part of the broaderTransformation & People Strategist network, contributing to collective intelligence and evolving our shared impact narrative.
Serve as an interpreter and translator of organizational intentions into daily practices that unlock tribe potential.
Lead or co-lead OKRs and Portfolio Management capability-building moments, contributing to a continuous improvement culture across the tribe.
Partner with Scrum Masters and POsto boost team effectiveness and overcome delivery blockers.
Lead or co-lead CoPsand capability-building initiatives, contributing to a continuous improvement culture across the Tribe.
You are a strong fit if you…
Thrive in both functional and cross-functional environments and lead through influence, not hierarchy.
Know how to balance speed with people focus, and delivery with development.
See transformation as a human-centered journey, not just a process.
Are a connector and a change leader with strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills.
See connections where others see isolated projects and join the dots.
Have strong project delivery skills and are comfortable running with complexity.
Communicate with clarity and precision, simplifying complex data and challenging assumptions constructively.
Combine empathy with sharp thinking, bringing energy into conversations and translating insights into concrete actions.
Love working with data and people to unlock patterns and simplify complexity.
Are energizing, structured, a sharp listener—and someone who acts.
Are confident navigating ambiguity, connecting dots and challenging assumptions constructively.
What we’re looking for
You are a strategic activator and a hands-on integrator. You know how to connect teams, execution and leadership.
Master’s or bachelor’s degree
Someone who can build trust, co-create, and integrate. You know how to connect teams, people and strategies.
Mindset grounded in growth, ownership and transformation.
Solid understanding of Delivery Framework, OKRs, and Tribe-level operating models.
Experience with topics such as performance, talent, leadership, engagement strategy or business transformation.
Proven ability to influence stakeholders, tech and people leaders alike.
Self-organized and able to simplify in essential elements to accomplish the goals
Strong project management skills, from facilitating conversations and turning insights into action to implementing and tracking.
Experience in running, coaching or supporting performance execution (data, cadence, visibility).
